periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45 degrees downward orientation relative to the horizontal axis of the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ellipsoid profile with a width-to-height ratio of approximately 1.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Moderate downward tapering at the anterior-inferior margin of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped curve along the posterior boundary of the dark band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Occupies approximately 40 percent of the visible dorsal-to-ventral torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semicircular convex curvature at the visible pinna apex.
